newsitem.title: CANADA: CWB details elevator space, railcar unload at port.
newsitem.headline: CWB details elevator space, railcar unload at port.

text.p: The Canadian Wheat Board on Tuesday detailed the amount of space available in primary elevators across the Prairies and the number of rail hopper car unloads at export position, a CWB statement said.

Alberta reported the most primary elevator space available at 49 percent, compared with 51 percent the previous week. Manitoba had 47 percent of space available versus 57 percent last week and Saskatchewan reported 43 percent of space available compared to 45 percent last week.
Rail car unloads at the West Coast totalled 2,269 hopper cars, beneath the 2,290 target for Aug 26 to Sept 1.
Rail car unloads at Thunder Bay totalled 1,400 hopper cars, up from the 1,065 target.
Rail car unloads at Churchill totalled 232, beneath the 300 car target.
